blurb: The Super fast 95' Norma-K III is powered by three 3412 Turbo charged Cat Diesel engines. She is equipped with the latest electronic equipment for fish finding and safety. Cleanest boat on the coast and comfortable, sailing year round! Free bait and instruction from our courteous and helpful crew. Both men's and lady's accommodations on board.
